senses.definition: A geographical area under the remote control of a country; especially to extract resources or exploit labor from that area.
examples: Much of the eastern United States was formerly a British colony; other areas were French, Spanish, Dutch, or Swedish colonies.
Bermuda is a crown colony of Great Britain.

senses.definition: A group of people who settle an area and maintain ties to their country of origin.
examples: a colony of British expats in Spain
The Amana Colonies in Iowa were settled by people from Germany.

quotes.text: The question of ecclesiastical jurisdiction had to be answered before the colony sailed for East Florida.

senses.definition: A group of people with similar interests, occupations, or characteristics, living in a particular area; the area such people occupy.
examples: a nudist colony; the statue was put up right in the middle of the artist colony
a leper colony on the outskirts of town; most buildings in the penal colony were made of concrete

senses.definition: (biology) A group of organisms of same or different species living together in close association.
examples: a colony of specialized polyps and medusoids

quotes.text: In the small hours came the fetid smell of a flying-fox colony.

A potential new chapter of a fraternity or sorority awaiting official recognition from their headquarters.
